name: Rocket Propulsion Fundamentals
summary: The quantitative basics of rocket propulsion: the rocket equation, thrust, specific impulse, ideal rocket theory, nozzles and staging.

topics.name: Momentum thrust, pressure thrust and the rocket thrust equation
Total impulse, specific impulse and effective exhaust velocity
The Tsiolkovsky rocket equation and mass ratio
Delta-v budgets: gravity losses, drag losses and steering losses
Multistage rockets: series and parallel staging, optimal staging
Isentropic nozzle flow: exhaust velocity and area ratio
Energy and efficiencies of rocket propulsion
Thrust-to-weight ratio and structural mass fraction
Rocket flight performance in gravity-free, gravity and atmospheric flight
